title: Warm Nutty Venezuelan Corn Flatbread
description: A crispy and nutty flatbread from Venezuela, perfect for snacking during monsoon season, made with sesame seed oil and a mirepoix base, following ayurvedic tamasic friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat a tava griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, mix together cornmeal, sesame seed oil, chopped onion, carrot, and celery.
Add salt and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Gradually add water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal parts and roll each part into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a flatbread on the preheated tava griddle and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
